slug.basis: Product name; zone would read as a Compute Engine zone; principles 1, 3; GitHub code search 2026-10-11 ("-xxx-" "resource \"google_dns_managed_zone\"" extension:tf, 1844 files): dns 189 / zone 117 / mz 7 / dz 0; no overlap with other abbreviations, kind tokens, environment values or region codes (catalog collision tests, 2026-10-11)

rows.info: A Cloud DNS zone that holds the records of one DNS name; this is the resource name, not the DNS name itself.

slug.basis: Meaning first: job is a usage value in shared links and stays free, scheduler is long; principles 1, 3; GitHub code search 2026-10-11 ("-xxx-" "resource \"google_cloud_scheduler_job\"" extension:tf, 2608 files): scheduler 204 / job 115 / cron 35 / sch 3; no overlap with other abbreviations, kind tokens, environment values or region codes (catalog collision tests, 2026-10-11)

rows.info: A Cloud Scheduler cron job; letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, at most 500 characters, unique within the project.

slug.basis: Product short form; counted with underscores because dataset IDs allow no hyphens; principles 1, 3; GitHub code search 2026-10-11 ("-xxx-" "resource \"google_bigquery_dataset\"" extension:tf, 5760 files): with "_xxx_": dataset 2648 (inflated by type names) / bq 646 / ds 45 / bqds 1; no overlap with other abbreviations, kind tokens, environment values or region codes (catalog collision tests, 2026-10-11)

rows.info: A BigQuery dataset; letters, digits and underscores only (no hyphens), so the tokens are joined with underscores. The name cannot be changed later.

slug.basis: Common short form of table, shorter than the word and read the same in SQL; joined with underscores like the dataset so a query can name the table without quotes; principles 1, 3; no overlap with other abbreviations, kind tokens, environment values or region codes (catalog collision tests, 2026-10-24)

rows.info: A BigQuery table or view inside a dataset; Cloudonym accepts ASCII letters, digits, underscores, hyphens and spaces, at most 1,024 characters (the limit is 1,024 UTF-8 bytes), unique per dataset. Generated names are joined with underscores.

slug.basis: Product name (5 letters, principle 2 exception); rds reads as AWS RDS; principle 3; GitHub code search 2026-10-11 ("-xxx-" "resource \"google_redis_instance\"" extension:tf, 1520 files): redis 289 / cache 72 / rds 3 / mrs 0 / mem 0; no overlap with other abbreviations, kind tokens, environment values or region codes (catalog collision tests, 2026-10-11)

rows.info: A Memorystore for Redis instance; lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 40 characters, unique per region and project.

slug.basis: Plain word (5 letters, principle 2 exception); short forms are unused; principle 3; GitHub code search 2026-10-11 ("-xxx-" "resource \"google_cloud_tasks_queue\"" extension:tf, 417 files): queue 46 / tasks 34 / que 0 / tq 0 / ctq 0; no overlap with other abbreviations, kind tokens, environment values or region codes (catalog collision tests, 2026-10-11)

rows.info: A Cloud Tasks queue; letters, digits and hyphens, at most 100 characters. A deleted queue name can be reused only after 3 days.
